_derivation: Hand-authored predictions from the reasoning in DATA.md: a shuffle boundary appears wherever rows must meet by key; a stage ends at each boundary; a reduce stage has spark.sql.shuffle.partitions tasks when adaptive execution is off; a broadcast replaces the fact-side shuffle with a copy of the small side; explain() plans without starting a job. The first ten entries were written before any run. The adaptive_skew_join operator names are Spark's own plan vocabulary (SortMergeJoin(skew=true), an AQEShuffleRead marked skewed); they were written after a probe run confirmed how Spark 4.0.4 prints them, and they come from Spark, never from the solution under test. Which side an adaptive broadcast builds is deliberately not predicted: it is recorded as an observation.
